text: Bhai, main samajh sakta hoon aapka gussa bilkul jayaz hai. Maine aapki request ko senior team aur escalation queue mein daal diya hai. Aapko jald hi hamari senior team se call back aayegi jo courier partner se baat karke aapka jacket aaj raat tak deliver karane ki koshish karenge. Thoda sa samay dijiye, aapko turant call aayegi.
